intro: A Seattle surf-noir band led by Shana Cleveland.
story: La Luz is a Seattle surf-noir band formed in 2012 and led by guitarist Shana Cleveland, who signed to Hardly Art after the Damp Face EP. Weirdo Shrine, made in a makeshift surf-shop studio with Ty Segall producing, came out in 2015, and they played Pickathon in 2016. Floating Features followed in 2018 and News of the Universe on Sub Pop in 2024. In 2026 came the EP Extra! Extra!
artist_reel_line: In 2026 they released the EP Extra! Extra!

intro: A Canadian songwriter who records at home.
story: Mac DeMarco is a Canadian songwriter who recorded as Makeout Videotape before signing to Captured Tracks in 2012. Salad Days, made in his Brooklyn apartment in 2014, won Pitchfork's Best New Music and made the Polaris Prize shortlist; he played Pickathon that year and again in 2016. This Old Dog came in 2017 and Here Comes the Cowboy in 2019, after he left Captured Tracks to start his own label. Guitar followed in 2025, and in November 2026 he toured Mexico.
artist_reel_line: He toured Mexico in November 2026 after releasing Guitar.

intro: A Chicago-born songwriter who signed to Bella Union.
story: Ezra Furman led Ezra Furman and the Harpoons until 2011 and signed to Bella Union in 2015. Furman played Pickathon in 2016, the year after Perpetual Motion People, and returned in 2018, the year of Transangelic Exodus, a near-novel concept record. Twelve Nudes came in 2019 and All of Us Flames in 2022. Goodbye Small Head followed in 2025, and in 2026 came a tour of Europe and the U.K.
artist_reel_line: Goodbye Small Head came in 2025, with a 2026 U.K. and European tour.

intro: A British rhythm-and-blues singer with a horn-driven band.
story: James Hunter is a British soul singer who debuted solo in 1996 on Ace after fronting Howlin' Wilf and the Vee-Jays, and Van Morrison once had him in his band. Hold On!, in 2016, was his first for Daptone, produced by Gabriel Roth and recorded live to eight-track tape, and The James Hunter Six played Pickathon that year. Whatever It Takes came in 2018 and Nick of Time in 2020. In January 2026 they opened a new chapter with a debut for Dan Auerbach's Easy Eye Sound label.
artist_reel_line: In January 2026 they released a debut for Dan Auerbach's Easy Eye Sound.
